limits.preexisting_inner_native_evidence_except: UNCHANGED; the new helper preserves the exception active at the outer shutdown boundary

verified_behavior: Outer cleanup starts immediately before first boot, after unchanged platform/source/preflight/job-owned-name/disk/helper checks. Untrusted source, mismatched preflight or foreign simulator name causes no simulator command.

The one original exact-UDID shutdown is moved to the outer finalizer. Command is xcrun simctl shutdown <validated UDID>, timeout120 and check=False. No retry, delete, erase, list-all or global simulator action is added.

Boot120 and bootstatus180 command limits are unchanged. Boot timeout/cancellation, post-boot lookup failure and runtime download/build failure reach shutdown without entering native account/credential evidence finalization.
Original native phase, final-container lookup and native evidence failures still reach outer shutdown. Native evidence and credential finalization remain scoped inside the actual native lifecycle.

A primary exception active when shutdown begins remains the propagated exception if shutdown or its receipt write raises. Secondary cleanup error types are retained in the result. With no primary, a cleanup error still raises and blocks a successful lane.
Nonzero shutdown return is now explicitly rejected and recorded FAIL even though run_logged uses check=False. No failed command is labeled successful cleanup.
Successful native pair phase order is unchanged. Required private evidence is finalized before shutdown; optional native UI continuation remains after successful pair shutdown.
Product/Go/Swift fixtures, runtime pins, native acceptance checks, app build flags and source validations are unchanged. Only controller cleanup coverage and its targeted tests change.
